title: NURO finding things on the seafloor

tellings.quote: >> It seems like they might be finding things on the seafloor. >> Yep. They are

plain: The National Underwater Reconnaissance Office, a little-known US body known as NURO, may be finding unexplained things on the ocean floor. When Michels put it to John S. Herrington, the Secretary of Energy, that "they might be finding things on the seafloor," Herrington answered: "Yep. They are." Coming from a cabinet official, that short answer would mean the government knows of strange objects under the sea.
